title: Transformers in Practice
description: Go beyond just using LLMs to actually understanding them. In this course taught by Sharon Zhou, you'll build the intuition to reason about model behavior, debug real problems, and make smarter decisions about deploying transformer-based models.

title: Build Interactive Agents with Generative UI
description: Build fullstack agent apps that go beyond plain text, generating custom UIs like charts, forms, and whiteboards on demand.

title: Gemini CLI: Code & Create with an Open-Source Agent

title: Document AI: From OCR to Agentic Doc Extraction

title: Build with Andrew

description: Learn how to use and prompt OpenAI's o1 model for complex reasoning tasks.
